title: Obugumiikiriza Obuwangaala Okusinga Ennaku
intro: Omukadde obugumiikiriza bwe bwafuuka obw’olugero, okwolesebwa kwe ne kuggwaawo olw’ennaku, naye ng’okukkiriza kwe mu nteekateeka ey’obwakatonda tekuwuguka. Ono ssekinnoomu yalaba abaana ab’obulenzi kkumi na babiri nga bakula ne bafuuka emisingi gy’ebika, n’afiirwa omwana omwagalwa ennyo mu ngeri eruma, era n’afuuka akabonero akataggwaawo ak’obugumiikiriza obulungi mu maaso g’ennaku esukkiridde. Omwoyo ogw’ekitiibwa ng’emboozi yaayo eyogerwa mu mpapula z’okubikkulirwa. Osobola okuzuula omuwendo guno okuva mu Quran?
clues: Nnali nnabbi ng’emboozi ye eyogerwa mu bujjuvu mu surah enkulu eya Quran.
Nnalina abaana ab’obulenzi kkumi na babiri abaazaala ebika bya Bani Isirayiri.
Nagamba batabani bange okuyingira nga bayita mu miryango egy’enjawulo, baleme okumanyibwa ng’abantu abali obwannamunigina.
Amaaso gange gaamwerusa olw’okukaaba okutasalako olw’omwana omwagalwa eyanzigyako.
Nagaana okuggwaamu essuubi ne bwe batabani bange abalala bankuutira, nga bagamba nti nneemulugunya eri Allah yekka.
Nze taata wa nabbi Yusuf, erinnya lye lyenyini litegeeza ‘the augmenter’ mu Luwarabu.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
